message: Opening proposal from Trinity Castings: $6.20 per unit, lots of 20 to 100 units, 30% paid at shipment, 50% at receipt and the remaining 20% at inspection, 21-day lead time with a 3-day grace period. A late shipment is cut 1% per day, capped at 5%. Orders can be cancelled within 14 days, and goods are deemed accepted after 4 days. A person at our company must sign before this takes effect.
